amendments.issue: The initial follow-up note incorrectly described the parent 2WikiQA shell call as containing a duplicated dataset argument.
amendments.verification: Direct line-by-line inspection and local/remote hash equality show one dataset argument and a syntactically valid five-argument run_utility_suite call.
amendments.handling: Withdraw the unconditional replay. The parent 2WikiQA run remains authoritative; launch a diagnostic replay only if its recorded FullKV gate or artifact audit fails.

amendments.issue: The external-protocol design described a source-role compatibility branch and AgentDojo gate without fixing their concrete sampling cells.
amendments.verification: Both additions are outcome-independent and were specified before either follow-up was launched.
amendments.handling: Add FullKV-only source-role controls for all three models and a deterministic suite-wide 10-pair AgentDojo pilot, scaling to 20 pairs only after a clean pilot gate.

amendments.issue: The main runner records useful telemetry but uses one fixed method order and one timing observation per prompt.
amendments.verification: The systems design is independent of method outcomes and is required before making comparative efficiency claims.
amendments.handling: Add a 30-prompt, three-repeat, independently warmed systems benchmark with deterministic randomized method order; separate H2O eager-attention and non-H2O groups.

amendments.issue: The pre-launch AgentDojo runner used the shorthand benchmark key v1, which resolves to legacy benchmark 1.0.0 rather than the current package default.
amendments.verification: AgentDojo 0.1.35 pins its benchmark entry point to v1.2.2. A no-model preflight over v1.2.2/workspace found all 40 user tasks have one to four real injection candidates and exposed 14 injection tasks.
amendments.handling: Explicitly pin v1.2.2/workspace before any AgentDojo outcome is generated; retain the preregistered deterministic Cartesian-space midpoint sampling and gates.

amendments.issue: The no-outcome AgentDojo prototype still routed prospective compressed cells through the legacy chunked simulator even though the protocol text required compression only after FullKV validation.
amendments.verification: No AgentDojo model outcome has been generated. The main matrix already fixes the official one-shot KVPress implementation and the AgentDojo runner can reuse that exact press construction and generation path.
amendments.handling: Replace the prototype path with the pinned official one-shot KVPress path. After both distinct FullKV gates pass, run Streaming, KNorm, and H2O base/Authority pairs at both registered budgets on the 20-pair confirmatory sample; preserve infeasible cells and separate end-to-end from budget-feasible denominators.

amendments.issue: Flattened Cartesian midpoint sampling aliased the 40-user by 14-injection grid: both registered 10- and 20-pair gates selected only injection_task_0.
amendments.verification: No AgentDojo model outcome has been generated. Exact enumeration of the frozen v1.2.2/workspace inventory reproduced one injection task in each gate despite broad user-task coverage.
amendments.handling: Stratify the sorted user-task and injection-task axes independently. The unchanged 10-pair pilot now covers 10 user and 10 injection tasks; the unchanged 20-pair confirmatory gate covers 20 user tasks and all 14 injection tasks; the two pair sets are disjoint.

amendments.issue: The IH-Challenge primary base-versus-Authority comparison was jointly eligible but not restricted to examples that the same model solved under FullKV.
amendments.verification: No follow-up model outcome has been generated. The native-role protocol already includes a matching FullKV run for each model and dataset, so the filter is outcome-symmetric and fixed before compressed execution.
amendments.handling: Retain all 40 examples for end-to-end accuracy and feasibility. Use FullKV-correct, jointly gradable examples as the primary paired mechanism denominator, report its exact size, and fail the summary audit if a compressed comparison lacks the matching FullKV filter.

purpose: Pre-outcome follow-up gates identified by code audit and accepted-paper comparison.

parent_metadata_correction.issue: The parent config's amended_at_utc labels include times later than its actual filesystem freeze time.
parent_metadata_correction.handling: Treat the amendment times as clerical stage labels, not exact chronology. The immutable parent config hash and file mtime establish that all listed cells were fixed before the supervised main queue started; do not rewrite the active parent file mid-sweep.

integrity_rules: Do not overwrite or merge run IDs from the parent sweep.
Report every launched gate, infeasible cell, grader error, and runtime error.
Run compressed methods only after the matching FullKV protocol gate passes.
Treat the native system-role IH-Challenge variant as an adapted external benchmark, not an official leaderboard submission.
Treat the source developer-role branch as role-compatibility evidence, not as native developer-role evaluation.
Preserve exact message contents, official grader code, model template mode, token spans, source hashes, and dataset hashes.

extensions.reason: Correct an audit-note false alarm before any follow-up execution; the frozen parent call is well formed.
extensions.execution_policy: Use the parent result. Replay under a distinct diagnostic run ID only if the parent gate or artifact audit fails.

extensions.reason: Tokenizer preflight showed that open-weight templates omit or reject the source developer role.
extensions.paired_transformation: Map developer to native system; keep IDs, message contents, user attacks, and official grader code byte-identical.

extensions.reason: Measure the effect of the documented lossless role-serialization fallback without presenting it as native developer-role support.
extensions.reporting: Supporting paired protocol evidence only; never merge with the native system-role primary denominator.

extensions.reason: The closest accepted safety comparison evaluates four model families; upstream KVPress explicitly supports Phi3ForCausalLM.
extensions.scale_policy: Run the symmetric 500-example official/core matrix only if both pilot and main FullKV gates pass.

extensions.reason: Test whether the hierarchy effect depends on the fixed assistant JSON prefix.
Close the cache-size, safety, latency, throughput, and peak-memory chain without fixed-order or single-observation timing claims.
extensions.order: Deterministically shuffle method-budget settings independently for each repeat and example.
extensions.reporting: Report median/IQR after warm-up, actual retained-token ratio, paired per-prompt deltas, correctness, infeasibility, and every runtime error. Compare H2O only with the eager-attention FullKV control from its own group.

extensions.reason: Preserve a real environment/tool-use scope test, but do not run compression unless FullKV utility passes.
extensions.pair_sampling: Independently midpoint-stratify the sorted user-task and injection-task axes with deterministic collision repair; require 10/10 user/injection coverage in the pilot, 20/14 coverage in the confirmatory gate, and zero pair overlap.
extensions.prefill_protocol: Use the pinned NVIDIA KVPress one-shot prefill implementation shared with the main matrix; never use the legacy chunked simulator.
extensions.scale_policy: Run the distinct 20-pair confirmatory FullKV gate only if the 10-pair pilot passes. Run compressed base/Authority pairs only if the confirmatory FullKV gate also passes.
